product_metadata.title: Vimukun Single Serve Coffee Maker, Coffee Brewer for K-Cup Single Cup Capsule and Ground Coffee, Single Cup Coffee Makers with 6 to 14oz Reservoir, Small Size (Blue)
features: 2 Ways for Brewing Coffee: The single serve coffee maker makes it compatible with ground coffee and K-cup pods. You can choose your favorite coffee style and brewing your exclusive style of coffee. This coffee brewer suit for k-cup coffee and ground coffee in one.

1 Click for All Your Needs: The single-serve brewers is easy to use, fill water in the reservoir of the coffee machine, add a cup or pour grounds in the mesh filter, then press the button and wait for about 2 minutes to enjoy your coffee. As well as cleaning easily with that, too. No need to worry if you forget to shut off the coffee maker, the machine will turn off automatically.

Slim & Compact design: The single cup coffee maker just takes a little bit to make one cup of coffee in a machine that's the size of a desk lamp. The compact size is very suitable for installation on countertops or office tables.

Choose Your Coffee Strength and Cup Size: It is convenient to customize your own style of coffee. The water reservoir has a capacity of 6-14 OZ and allows you to control how much coffee you want to brew the grounds coffee. It is also compatible with the coffee mug, Please make sure your coffee cup size is between 4.3in and 4.7in.

Best Solution for Travel or Business: With the most compact design and durable construction, this one cup coffee maker is perfect for home, office, dorm room, apartment, caravan, traveling, etc. Just enjoy your coffee everywhere. Only be used for 120V voltage.
